lines.en: I appear suddenly in the doorway.
A second ago this space was empty.
I didn't walk over here.
You turn your eyes, and I'm there.
When I appear, every sound stops.

lines.zh: 我一步一步往你那边挪
lines.en: I edge toward you, step by step.
The floor doesn't creak under me.
I move from the light into the dark.
A second shadow has joined yours.
Every step I take closes the gap.
The corridor has grown longer.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向挪了一下
lines.en: I shift in your direction.
I stand like this, unmoving.
You don't dare look again, do you?
My face is turned toward you.
The lamp flickers. I don't.
I wait for your next breath.
This room is too quiet.
I stand at the edge of your sight.
Count to three and you'll see me.
I haven't shifted an inch.
There's nothing I need to do.
You can hear your own heart.
I'm waiting right here.
The door never opened.
You'll lift your head again.
Don't turn your head. There's still time.
I'm directly in front of you.
Only now do you see me.
That thing just now — that was me.
Your hand has frozen mid-air.
I've been waiting for this glance.
Don't scream. Nothing will come out.
Have you seen my face clearly?
This isn't the face you imagined.
I'm two steps from you now.
Your breathing stopped for a moment.
I haven't done anything at all.

lines.zh: 你的影子在往我这边倒
lines.en: Your shadow leans toward me.
One more look and you'll remember.
You want to close your eyes, don't you?
Closing them won't help.
I'm still standing where I was.
But one blink will change that.
This is how I arrive.
Now. Don't breathe.
You didn't hit anything.
I didn't even dodge.
Your hand went straight through.

lines.zh: 你背后那口气是我呼的。
lines.en: The breath on your neck is mine.
It doesn't hurt. I feel nothing.
You want me to be hurt.
I was never alive.
You're still swinging at nothing.
You struck the me that was there a moment ago.
Now it is your turn to close your eyes.
You think that will soothe me.
I see it, and I don't want it.
You hold it up and step back.
This won't make me vanish.

lines.zh: 我把视线移到别处去了
lines.en: I've looked away to something else.
Is that all you have?
I move only when your eyes shut.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，声音会引来别的
lines.en: Put it away. Sound draws others.
I haven't even glanced at it.

lines.zh: 你还有多少可以拿出来
lines.en: How much more can you pull out?
You lunge at nothing; I recede.

lines.zh: 你穿过了我刚才的位置
lines.en: You passed through where I was.
Half a block is all there is between us.

lines.zh: 你的手碰到很冷的东西
lines.en: Your hand met something very cold.
After the contact, I've moved.
You've backed into the wall.
I'm behind the wall as well.
The door you hit was open.
I can't be pushed.
You're losing your sense of direction.

lines.zh: 你愿意和我一起待着吗
lines.en: Will you stay here with me?
I count to ten - still there?
Stay, and you won't be afraid.
Your place is already set.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，你也不敢动。
lines.en: I stand still, and you dare not move.
Just keep your eyes on me.
Don't turn around. This is good.
I've never had company.
You'll get used to it.
It only takes a little time.
My hand can't reach the floor.

lines.zh: 东西落在我脚边，我不捡
lines.en: It fell at my feet. I don't pick it up.
It's on the ground; I'm above it.
You pick it up. I'll watch.
That's where it will stay.
There's nothing I want to take.
I don't touch anything.
It's older than it was a moment ago.

lines.zh: 你看它的时候，我在看你
lines.en: While you look at it, I look at you.
Leave it.
You looked back.
You glanced back just now.
You're the only one here.
The door has closed behind you.
Did you hear that?
You're still standing where you were.
I needn't close in too fast.
You'll come to me on your own.
There's one more shadow on the wall.
The lamp is about to die.
I'm counting the time.
Your shadow is shrinking.
This space is mine.
These four walls answer to me.
Let's begin. Don't be afraid.
I said, don't be afraid.

lines.zh: 我的名字，只有一个问号。
lines.en: My name is just a question mark.
Behind that corner is my side.
I don't walk. I appear.
You're looking at something behind me.
There's nothing behind me.
Your breathing is getting louder.
I stop three steps away.
The pause is worse than the approach.
You're waiting for me to speak.
I won't say anything.

lines.zh: 你在猜我下一步，我不动。
lines.en: You are guessing my next move; I do not move.
Guessing wrong is fine.
I keep watching your hands.
Your hands have lost their strength.
This room is getting smaller.
You heard something inside the wall.
That wasn't me.
That was me.
Now. Look up.
Don't look up.
I didn't strike.

lines.zh: 我的手从你的影子里伸出。
lines.en: My hand reaches out of your shadow.
Those weren't my nails.

lines.zh: 你听见自己骨头响了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear your own bones creak?
I never came close.

lines.zh: 你只是站在了错的地方
lines.en: You only stood in the wrong place.
The room is pressing in on you.
I stand still, and you're hurt.
You're losing the edges of things.
I've been right in front of you.
You turned around. So.
So I came.

lines.zh: 你还有一点时间，用掉它。
lines.en: You have a little time left; use it.
A moment ago this spot was empty.

lines.zh: 六百六十六点，就为了吓你。
lines.en: Six hundred sixty-six, all to scare you.

lines.zh: 眨眼那一下，我就换了位置。
lines.en: The moment you blink, I am elsewhere.
In the instant the lamp died, I was there.

lines.zh: 你听见的第一声不是风
lines.en: The first sound you heard wasn't wind.
This room didn't have me in it before.
I appeared while you were looking down.
I stand on ground that was empty.
The air cooled first, then came me.
Your torch flickered twice.

lines.zh: 你数过房间里有几个人吗
lines.en: Did you count how many were in the room?
Now it's two.

lines.zh: 我一直等着你转过头来。
lines.en: I have been waiting for you to turn around.
I've prepared a long time for this look.
Don't run. The door is locked.

lines.zh: 你听见的脚步声是我的
lines.en: Those footsteps you heard are mine.
But I didn't walk.
This room will remember you.
So will I.
You came earlier than I expected.
No matter. There's time enough.
We'll take it slowly.
Now. Stay still.

lines.zh: 火光里，我的轮廓更清楚
lines.en: In firelight my outline grows clearer.
There's no floor beneath me.
The water flows around me.
After the noise, I'm still standing.
The arrow stops an inch from me.
This light can't pierce me.
I never eat; I only stand here.
In the lightning, half the room is empty.
I fall with you.
